limitations: Local fixed 12/8-customer order bursts; not production throughput or breakpoint capacity.
Logical latency includes all bounded retries; HTTP attempt counts and retryable conflicts are retained separately.
Only pending unpaid orders are created; no payment capture, confirmation or hosted realtime delivery is exercised.
Small per-stage samples limit tail-latency certainty; CPU is API/collector only and network counters cover loopback HTTP.

monitoring.processScope: API and collector process; fixture generation shares this process during setup. Search clients run in a separate process.
monitoring.networkScope: Observed loopback HTTP socket bytes, including headers; not NIC/WAN or database protocol bandwidth.

dataset.assumption: Local expected-use planning baseline; not a measured production forecast.
